test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025: Morning Practice Day 2
subject: general
question: Six persons Geo, Leo, Meo, Neo, Peo and Yeo are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order. Yeo sits third to the left of Meo. Only Peo sits to the right of Meo. Neo is an immediate neighbour of Geo but not Yeo. Which of the following pairs sits at the extreme ends of the row?
solution:
Six persons: Geo, Leo, Meo, Neo, Peo and Yeo

i) Yeo sits third to the left of Meo.

ii) Only Peo sits to the right of Meo. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2632b0dbf89518760a2654a51591f4ac441cd01c34e0b47316122aead118fcd.png] 

iii) Neo is an immediate neighbour of Geo but not Yeo.

This also determines the position of Leo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2303d52894dfeb3a775b817df2c4155fd357d6cd04aaa9fe21f7e961a02e61c.png] 

Hence, Leo and Peo sits at the extreme ends of the row.
